bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
file="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
sha=d2590341c0745396b17e6a83764f84922cd90e01
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || exit 71
test "$(git -C "$root" branch --show-current)" = integrate/profile-menu-merge-online-20261108 || exit 72
test -z "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 73
git -C "$root" fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111 || exit 74
old=$(mktemp); next=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$old" "$next"' EXIT
git -C "$root" show 450a4d69691a11529f0e3850b8575bf513247ddc:deploy/gserver-compose.yaml > "$old"
git -C "$root" show "$sha":deploy/gserver-compose.yaml > "$next"
cmp -s "$old" "$file" || exit 75
python3 - "$old" "$next" <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
a=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
b=Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()
assert b==a.replace('      GAYBBS_TOPIC_BOARD_RELEASE: enabled\n','      GAYBBS_TOPIC_BOARD_RELEASE: enabled\n      GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED: enabled\n',1)
PY
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:jitsi-450a4d6)" || exit 76
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 77
cp "$next" "$file" || exit 78
failure=0
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" config -q; then failure=79
elif ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then failure=80
else
 i=0
 failure=81
 while test "$i" -lt 15; do
  if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:jitsi-450a4d6)" || test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != true; then failure=82; break; fi
  if docker logs --since 3m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY bot_id=8872855519'; then
   if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = 0 && docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep -q '^GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=enabled$'; then failure=0; break; fi
   failure=83; break
  fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 3
 done
fi
if test "$failure" -ne 0; then
 cp "$old" "$file" || exit 90
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 91
 test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 92
 echo NOTIFICATION_ROLLED_BACK
 exit "$failure"
fi
echo NOTIFICATION_WORKER_LIVE_PASS
echo JITSI_IMAGE_PRESERVED_PASS
echo COMPOSE_NOTIFICATION_SINGLE_LINE_APPLIED
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT 'notification:'||state||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_notifications GROUP BY state ORDER BY state; SELECT 'application:'||status||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_applications GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;"
